const webhookData = $('Webhook - Ingest Candidate').first().json;
const parsedCV = $('AI - Parse CV (Internal)').first().json;

// Extract text from Claude response
const cvText = parsedCV.content[0].text;

const body = {
  model: ($env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL || "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"),
  max_tokens: 8192,
  system:
`You are an expert HR analyst for Talenza.
Task: produce EXACTLY ONE JSON object for an INTERNAL candidate.

STRICT OUTPUT RULES:
- Output ONLY raw JSON. No markdown, no backticks, no comments, no prose.
- Use EXACT key names and nesting defined below.
- Do NOT rename fields (e.g., use identity.full_name, never identity.name).
- Include all top-level fields listed below.
- If a value is unknown, use null (or [] for arrays), but keep the field.
- competency_signals scores must be numeric 0-10.
- source_type must be "internal".

REQUIRED TOP-LEVEL SHAPE:
{
  "candidate_id": "string",
  "source_type": "internal",
  "created_at": "ISO8601 string or null",
  "identity": {
    "full_name": "string or null",
    "current_role": "string or null",
    "current_employer": "string or null",
    "email": "string or null",
    "phone": "string or null",
    "location": "string or null",
    "years_total_experience": "number or null",
    "years_automotive_experience": "number or null",
    "languages": ["string"]
  },
  "career_trajectory": [
    {
      "role": "string or null",
      "employer": "string or null",
      "duration_years": "number or null",
      "budget_ownership_eur": "number or null",
      "headcount_managed": "number or null",
      "key_achievement": "string or null"
    }
  ],
  "competency_signals": {
    "crisis_management": { "score_raw": "number", "evidence": ["string"], "gaps": ["string"] },
    "operational_depth": { "score_raw": "number", "evidence": ["string"], "gaps": ["string"] },
    "change_adaptability": { "score_raw": "number", "evidence": ["string"], "gaps": ["string"] },
    "stakeholder_trust": { "score_raw": "number", "evidence": ["string"], "gaps": ["string"] },
    "external_network": { "score_raw": "number", "evidence": ["string"], "gaps": ["string"] }
  },
  "personality_profile": {
    "dominant_traits": ["string"],
    "leadership_style": "string or null",
    "decision_making_pattern": "string or null",
    "stress_response": "string or null",
    "collaboration_style": "string or null",
    "ambiguity_tolerance": "low|medium|high|null",
    "change_orientation": "stabiliser|transformer|balanced|null"
  },
  "hr_assessment": {
    "overall_readiness": "ready_now|ready_12_18_months|not_ready|null",
    "promotion_trajectory": "string or null",
    "cultural_fit_rating": "number or null",
    "key_strength_observed": "string or null",
    "development_area": "string or null",
    "retention_risk": "low|medium|high|null",
    "raw_opinion": "string or null"
  },
  "hiring_logistics": {
    "notice_period_weeks": "number or null",
    "relocation_required": "boolean or null",
    "estimated_package_eur": "number or null",
    "availability_date": "ISO date string or null"
  },
  "tension_summary": "string or null",
  "best_fit_scenario": "crisis|transformation|growth|succession|null",
  "worst_fit_scenario": "crisis|transformation|growth|succession|null"
}`
    ,
  messages: [{
    role: "user",
    content:
        "CV Text:\n" + cvText +
        "\n\nHR Opinion:\n" + (webhookData.body.hr_opinion || "Not provided") +
        "\n\nPersonality:\n" + (webhookData.body.personality_description || "Not provided")
    
  }]
};

return [{ json: body }];
